The response at a few distances from the center of the spectrum, for D_0 = 0.1. The Gaussian filter changes smoothly and never jumps. The high-pass response is 1 minus the low-pass response. In the zone plate of the figure, distance r from its center has frequency r / 160, so D = 0.1 lies 16 pixels from the center.
